hoyo-ae6fe9ce85.raw:
HoYoverse is committed to providing immersive virtual world experiences to players around the world. We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content.

Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community.

Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies.

In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.

When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy https://www.hoyoverse.com/en-us/legal/recruitment-privacy-policy.



職務内容：
・当社タイトルに関わる各種テキストの校正、校閲、リライト
・文化的リスク、トーンの不一致、および表現上の改善点の洗い出し
・関連部署に対し、日本語ネイティブとしての文化的知見およびプレイヤー視点でのフィードバックの提供
・校正・品質管理に関わるツールやワークフローの検証および改善への参加



―必須要件―
・日本語として正しく、違和感のない、表現力と魅力に富んだ文章に校正できる方
・既定のスタイルガイドに従って適切な文章に仕上げられる方
・物語に対する読解力があり、矛盾を見つけた際に調整できる文章力のある方
・日本の文化、トレンド、ネット用語、およびプレイヤーの行動に対する理解のある方
・AIをはじめとする新しいツールや技術に対して抵抗がない方
・中国語もしくは英語の文章を読解できる方（各種資料を確認できるレベル）
 
―歓迎要件―
・一定の文化、文学的知識について自信のある方
　例：日本の詩歌（古典/現代）、古文、歴史的仮名遣い、西洋詩、洋画翻訳口調など
・「言語能力 + α」のプロファイルをお持ちの方（例：言語能力 + 技術力・データ力・マーケティング力など）
・AIをはじめとする新しいツールを業務に取り入れた経験がある方
・中国語もしくは英語での業務コミュニケーションが可能な方
 
―求める人物像―
・業務に対する責任感や熱意のある方
・ゲームが好きな方
・「崩壊」シリーズ、「原神」、「ゼンレスゾーンゼロ」などの当社リリースタイトルのストーリーやキャラを理解している方
・オタク文化（マンガ、アニメ、ラノベ、ゲーム等）に詳しい方

We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

hoyo-6da6817c7e.raw:
HoYoverse is committed to providing immersive virtual world experiences to players around the world. We have brought fans popular games including Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Zenless Zone Zero, as well as a wide range of entertainment content.

Community is at the heart of everything we do. We are devoted to engaging fans and fostering an enthusiastic and inclusive global community.

Pushing the boundaries of imagination, we consistently explore cutting-edge game development technologies.

In the future, we will continue to expand our content production, technology research, and publishing duties through operations in offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.

When you apply to a position with HoYoverse, we will process your personal data. To learn more, please review our comprehensive Global Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy https://www.hoyoverse.com/en-us/legal/recruitment-privacy-policy.



工作职责：
1. 内容本地化与质量管理 

- 负责游戏内剧情、UI、系统玩法、活动规则、道具等各类内容的审校工作； 

- 维护或建立组内本地化指南、术语库及文风规范，并且确保组内整体内容风格与表达的一致性； - 在适配内部的部门交付标准前提下，维护繁中语组内的本地化质量标准；

- 工作中主动识别质量、进度、流程、舆情及政治等各类风险，及时进行风险暴露、跨方同步与推动解决，保障项目平稳落地。

2. QA及游戏内容测试 

- 在游戏内外环境中对文本、上下文、UI、演出等本地化内容进行测试与质量确认； - 识别翻译错误、语境不一致及与世界观设定不符的内容，并提出具体的修改建议；

- 与内外部合作伙伴保持紧密协作，推动项目顺利开展。

3. 人力管理与工作分工

- 基于本地化 PM 规划的项目节奏，进行合理的组内工作排期与任务分工，兼顾成员能力与项目优先级，确保任务的进度与质量按时交付；

- 负责组内成员的带教与培养，包括新人onboarding、术语与文风培训、审校技巧分享等，持续提升团队整体的专业能力；

- 关注组内伙伴的工作状态与成长需求，定期进行 1-on-1 沟通与反馈，营造积极、协作的团队氛围；

- 在跨组/跨部门协作中，作为繁中语组的对接窗口，代表团队参与讨论、评审与决策，推动资源协调与问题解决。



任职要求：
1. 语言能力 

- 简体中文及繁体中文精通或达到母语水平，具备扎实的双语理解与简体中文至繁体中文语的翻译能力；

- 具备优秀的繁体中文写作能力，能够产出准确、自然、流畅且符合语言习惯的繁中语内容； - 在充分保留原文含义与叙事意图的前提下，能够从繁中玩家的视角出发，对译文进行合理的重构与本地化改写，实现文化与语感层面的自然落地。 

2. 工作经验 

- 具备游戏翻译或本地化相关工作经验者优先；

- 熟练使用本地化相关软件工具（如 CAT 工具、QA 工具等）者优先；

- 具备 3–7 人小组协作或带队经验者优先，熟悉团队排期、沟通、与质量把控；

- 具备AI技术使用或Agent调试经验者优先。 

3. 个人能力 

- 能以开放的态度接受反馈，并进行理性、高效、以事论事的沟通；

- 重视团队合作，具备良好的协作意识与跨角色沟通能力；

- 具备敏锐的语言感知力，能够细致审视文本表达与文体差异，并持续打磨内容质量； - 关注整体游戏体验与内容完成度，具备产品思维，而非仅停留在字面翻译；

- 对所负责的项目具有强烈的责任感与主人翁意识，能够主动推进工作，不推诿、不逃避、不敷衍。

We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you're looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

About NetEaseGames: 
 As a leading internet technology company based in China, NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES and HKEX:9999, “NetEase”)provides premium online services centered around content creation. With extensive offerings across its expanding gaming ecosystem, the Company develops and operates some of China’s most popular and longest-running mobile and PC games. Powered by industry-leading in-house R&D capabilities in China and globally, NetEase creates superior gaming experiences, inspires players, and passionately delivers value for its thriving community worldwide. By infusing play with culture and education with technology, NetEase transforms gaming into meaningful vehicle to build a more entertaining and enlightened world. 
 NetEase’s ESG initiatives are among the best in the global media and entertainment industry, earning it a distinction as one of the S&P Global Industry Movers and an “A” rating from MSCI. For more information, please visit:  http://ir.netease.com/ 
 Responsibilities: 
 
 Responsible for the planning and execution of esports tournaments for shooting game products. Based on product highlights, features, and release timelines, designing online and offline tournament operation plans, building the official and third-party tournament ecosystem from the ground up, and ensuring effective implementation. 
 Develop and manage tournament partnership ecosystems, create diverse tournament content gameplay and third-party platform events to amplify game visibility and engagement. 
 Oversee tournament ecosystem operations, including scouting and maintaining relationships with professional players in official tournaments, executing incentive and operational policies, supporting high-quality tournament content and nurturing potential KOLs, as well as managing hot-topic activations at key milestones. 
 Integrate tournament planning, marketing strategies, and ecosystem operations, coordinating resources to achieve KPIs. Continuously track and analyze tournament data, user feedback, and market dynamics to iterate and optimize strategies for maximum project impact. 
 
 Requirements: 
 
 Bachelor’s degree or above, with 2+ years of experience in esports tournament operations. Prior experience in esports operation or successful execution of esports events is preferred; experience with shooting game tournaments is a plus. 
 Familiar with one or multiple mainstream esports event systems in the market, and well-acquainted with the ecosystem
quals: In-depth understanding of competitive gaming communities, ecosystems, tournament structures, and player dynamic.
Proficient in English, able to use it as a working language.
Note: All UK-based positions are eligible for visa sponsorship .

neg-5234305007.raw: About the Role We are looking for a Game Category Operations Executive to own and grow an assigned game category on our overseas game trading platform. You will drive end-to-end category operations — from trend monitoring and merchandising to campaigns and promotions — and collaborate cross-functionally to grow category transaction volume (GMV). Key Responsibilities - Own overall operations for an assigned game category: develop and execute operation plans covering game trend/hotspot monitoring, merchandising, campaign and promotion follow-through; coordinate with upstream and downstream partners to grow category transaction volume. - Take ownership of category transaction performance; identify growth opportunities through conversion funnel analysis and market insights. - Research games and their trading markets; propose operational strategies and product improvement directions. - Continuously monitor and analyse operational data of live game categories to identify issues and improve the user experience. - Develop a deep understanding of players' day-to-day gaming scenarios, resolve real user pain points, and uncover opportunities for trading or top-up/recharge services within these scenarios. Requirements - At least 1 year of experience in overseas game operations, with in-depth knowledge of at least one game genre (SLG, card games, or RPG) or pan-entertainment products, and a good grasp of industry trends. - Strong data analysis skills, with the ability to interpret operational metrics and translate them into actionable insights and optimisation plans. - Solid understanding of gamer communities — able to quickly identify where player groups gather, source relevant information, and apply it to drive business growth. - Innovative and self-driven, with strong learning ability, communication skills, and a collaborative mindset. Good to Have - Proficiency in additional foreign languages. - Overseas study or work experience.

 About the Role 
 As a core member of our corporate investment team, this role works closely with senior investment leaders on global initiatives spanning the full investment lifecycle. You will act as a trusted partner to our portfolio companies, help drive complex transactions to closing, and contribute to identifying the next wave of games and investment opportunities through industry research and network building.
